exposure: Substance use disorder counseling (inpatient vs. outpatient services)
cohort: A cohort of 430 people who inject drugs (PWID) with definite infective endocarditis (IE) admitted to five tertiary-care hospitals in Canada between 2007 and 2018.
finding: Women comprised over half of PWID with infective endocarditis (IE), and their mortality was higher if living in urban areas, while overall mortality was lower with inpatient substance use disorder services and right-sided IE, but higher with congestive heart failure.
